title: Morristown Central School enrolls 2 Asian and Pacific Islander students for 2025-26
text:
Morristown Central School reported an enrollment of two Asian and Pacific Islander students in the 2025-26 school year, a decrease of 33.3% from the prior year, as stated by the New York State Education Department .
Records indicated Morristown Central School had a total of 303 students in the 2025-26 school year. Asian and Pacific Islander students represented 0.7% of the student population, making them the second largest ethnic group at the school.
The school is part of the Morristown Central School District with its central office located in Morristown.
Within the district, Morristown Central School was the only institution to enroll Asian and Pacific Islander students that year, with two students counted.
World Population Review’s analysis notes that New York’s public school system was ranked second nationally , but 31st for K-12 performance.
